start: Watch app closed; the member starts a workout on the phone

steps.action: Start the workout on the phone
user_sees: A "Workout started" card with one buzz: "Tap to open MettleUp"
must_not: No card while the app is closed

user_sees: The app opens on the next set: "Next: Set 1 of 4 · Bench Press"
must_not: "Start a workout on your phone" while a workout is open

steps.action: Log the set on the phone
user_sees: The rest countdown on the watch within a few seconds
must_not: The watch stuck on the old set

start: The watch app installed (or reinstalled) in the middle of a workout

user_sees: The open workout and a running rest read from what the phone already holds
must_not: "Start a workout on your phone" until the next set is logged

start: A phone item arrives again late (re-delivered), or a rest arrives over a minute after its end (watch was away)

steps.action: The late item reaches the watch
user_sees: No buzz for a rest that ended long ago
must_not: An older set or rest put back over a newer one
A buzz in the middle of the next set

start: A workout open on the watch

user_sees: "Workout saved" "Well done. See the details on your phone." for about 4 seconds, then "Start a workout on your phone"
must_not: A rest still buzzing after the workout ended

user_sees: Straight back to "Start a workout on your phone"; any rest and "Rest is over" gone
must_not: A "Rest is over" card left for 2 minutes

start: Watch app closed; the phone writes a rest item (start, end, next set, Ring through Do Not Disturb)

steps.action: The item wakes the watch's listener
user_sees: The rest saved on the watch, its end alarm set and the countdown card shown
must_not: The item dropped because the app was closed

start: An item from the phone under another path, or one that cannot be read

user_sees: It is skipped and a line is logged
must_not: A rest or workout changed by it

start: A rest running on the watch

steps.action: The phone sends the rest cleared (skipped)
user_sees: The rest, its alarm and its card go; no buzz
must_not: A buzz for a skipped rest

steps.action: Next rest: the phone sends "ended" a few seconds before the watch's own alarm
user_sees: One buzz now; the watch's alarm does not buzz again
must_not: Two buzzes for the same rest
